```{r}
pw <- readLines("password.txt")

# f <- list.files(pattern = "^(q_|q\\d).{0,}\\.txt$")
# for(thisf in f){

#   newf <- gsub(".txt", ".bin", thisf, fixed = TRUE)
#   if(file.exists(newf)) file.remove(newf)
#   safer::save_object(qs, key = pw, conn = newf)
# }
quizfile <- "q3.bin"  

qs <- safer::retrieve_object(quizfile, key = pw)
qs <- split(qs, rep(1:(length(qs)/6), each = 6))
names(qs) <- paste0("Question ", seq_along(qs))
as <- lapply(qs, `[`, 6)
qs <- lapply(qs, function(x){
  out <- x[2:5]
  names(out)[1] <- "answer"
  out <- sample(out)
  out <- list(out)
  names(out) <- x[1]
  out
})
answerkey <- sapply(qs, function(x){LETTERS[which(names(x[[1]]) == "answer")]})

for (q in seq_along(qs))
{
  if(nchar(paste(c(names(qs[[q]])[1], unlist(qs[[q]])), collapse = " ")) < 461){
    cat(glue::glue("\n\n# Question {q}\n\n"))
  } else {
    cat(paste0("\n\n# Question ", q, " {.smaller}\n\n"))
  }
  
  cat(paste0("**", names(qs[[q]])[1], "**\n\n"))
  cat(paste0("**",LETTERS[seq_along(qs[[q]][[1]])], ".** ", qs[[q]][[1]]), sep = "\n\n")
}
cat("\n\n# Answers\n\n")
cat(paste0("* Question ", 1:length(qs), ": ", answerkey), sep = "\n")
cat("\n\n")

```

```{r}
for (q in seq_along(qs))
{
  cat(paste0("\n# Question ", q, " explained {.smaller}\n\n"))
  cat(paste0("**", names(qs[[q]])[1], "**\n\n"))
  cat(paste0("**", answerkey[q], ": ", qs[[q]][[1]]["answer"], "**\n\n"))
  # cat(paste0("**",LETTERS[seq_along(qs[[q]][[1]])], ".** ", qs[[q]][[1]]), sep = "\n\n")
  cat("\n")
  cat(as[[q]])
  cat("\n\n")
}
```
